name: INAE Travel Grant Scheme for Engineering Students from IITs/NITs/Govt. Approved Engineering Colleges/Institutions other than AICTE
benefit:
> **Financial Support**

**Financial Support for Physical Participation**

- Reimbursement of 100% of the registration fee.
- Reimbursement of 100% of the visa fee.
- Reimbursement of 50% of the actual airfare for discounted/concessional air tickets, provided the expenditure is not claimed from any other source.
- Reimbursement of travel expenses from the institution to the nearest airport and bac
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a pre-final or final year student of B.E./B.Tech or Integrated M.Tech; or 1. The applicant must be a first or second-year student of M.E./M.Tech; and 1. The applicant must be pursuing studies in an IIT, NIT, Government-approved Engineering College/Institution (other than AICTE-approved institutions), or another recognized university. 1. The applicant must have secured a minimum CGPA of 8.0 or equivalent percentage in the qualifying examination. 1. Possess a letter of acceptance for presenting a research paper at an international conference, seminar, symposium, workshop, exhibition, or similar scientific event held abroad. 1. The applicant has not previously received financial assistance under this scheme during the same course of study.
